INPUT AND OUTPUT CONTRACT

Input is one metadata-only JSON source snapshot, not arbitrary Python or SQL.
Provide: schema, documents, capture, records, question. Optional case_id is for
traceability only. The question describes the desired analysis purpose/population;
it should not contain private expected answers or anomaly labels.

schema maps each physical table name to keys, columns, references and optional
verified units. Composite occurrence identities must list their full key.
A reference is a column mapped to "Table.column". This physical description does
not itself certify a business requirement. Units must not be guessed from names.
records maps table names to arrays of scalar metadata rows. Exclude Body, payload,
message content and evaluation-only labels before preparing the snapshot. Actual
column inventory is checked against plans; records are not permitted arbitrary
nested content. Unknown metadata is null, not an invented normal/zero value.
Provide the projected row fields explicitly. JSON null denotes an observed or
explicitly unknown value. The current row evaluator does not separately model a
column omitted by a projection; do not use omitted fields to claim observed
missingness. Validate projections in the upstream CSV/JSON input preparation.

documents is an array of {id, authority, text}. Exact source spans are pinned.
HR authority requires an explicit verified requirement from verified_DDL or a
reviewed_business_contract; fictional tests use a separately named controlled
evaluation authority. Monitoring notes can support observational review but not
invent a prohibition. Current DDL applicability and business meanings must be
confirmed before presenting them as verified facts.

capture must include:
  Body_included: false
  source_version: a nonempty version string
  entity_family_complete: true or false
An affirmative completeness claim describes the admitted observation family; it
is not proof that the business behavior is correct. If coverage is unconfirmed,
use false. Supply shared_clock_verified only when supported; time comparisons
also require verified matching units. All related records needed for an absence
conclusion must be present in the admitted source family.

Generation is bounded to 2,000 metadata rows per snapshot and the pinned tokenizer
context budget. Preserve complete relation families when sampling. Do not quietly
truncate rows, documents or output. Full-batch CPU serving is a separate --bulk
path; it never forwards those full rows to the LLM.

AI output
0..4 candidates per generation call; this is not a global catalog-size target.
Each candidate has an ID, role, typed plan or null, source evidence, explanation,
normal exceptions, capture requirement and needed evidence. Supported plans are
row checks, scoped uniqueness, required/forbidden/exact-one relation checks,
verified predecessor order and unexplained-event review with OR alternatives.
Filter atoms within one selector are ANDed. A condition requiring OR must be
expressed with the supported alternatives or independently sufficient candidates.
No arbitrary generated code is executed.

conditional_row_check separates applicability from a local violation. Its
selector filter is the applicability condition A, and violation contains the
conjoined same-row violation atoms. A=false produces false (outside scope);
A=unknown produces unknown, even when the violation atoms would be false;
A=true evaluates the violation. This avoids hiding unknown applicability inside
an ordinary conjunction. Independently sufficient violations, such as each of
three independently required fields being null, need separate candidates that
are OR-composed. A single conjunction of all three null tests is too narrow.
At most four candidates can be returned by one call. The model is not guaranteed
to enumerate all required fields; source-level semantic review remains necessary.

Code output
candidate_pack.json preserves the original proposal, source/type/definition SHA,
model identity, validation errors, measured nullable values and pending reviews.
source_valid means executable source/type/grammar validity; it does not mean the
business meaning was approved. All raw attempts and errors remain available.

Frozen serving uses warning / nonwarning / unavailable. Required missing values,
uncertain relationships, incompatible schema/meaning versions and no executable
rule are never treated as proof of normality. OR composition gives warning if
any check fires; otherwise unresolved required checks preserve unavailable.
nonwarning means only that these admitted checks did not fire.

linked_feature_contracts, linked_rule_recommendations and linked_feature_values
share feature_id and feature_definition_sha256. A changed formula, source meaning,
capture requirement, type binding or validation policy creates a new definition.
Rules are exported disabled; no background activation, fit or threshold update
occurs. Source IDs identify relationships and provenance; they are not ML inputs.

discover accumulates proposals over bounded coverage passes. Earlier proposals
are marked UNAPPROVED and never become business evidence or teacher labels.
It stops at zero/new duplicates/holds, invalid output or the round budget. The
library preserves every pack and reports exact calculation signatures separately
from proposal counts. Exhaustive discovery and a desired rule count are not
guaranteed. A no-rule or held-evidence pack keeps incomplete coverage explicit.
